questions.question: A man cycling at a uniform speed of 10 km/h crosses a bridge in 90 seconds. The length of the bridge is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

speed = 10km/h

Time = 90 seconds

**Formula used**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation**

1 hour = 3600 seconds

1 km = 1000 m

10km = 10,000 m

Distance = (10,000/3600) × 90

⇒ 250 m

**∴ The length of the bridge is 250 m**

questions.question: Ranjan in his ODI Cricket career, scored 15 runs on an average in 10 matches. If he scored 14 runs on an average in the first 4 matches and 12 runs on an average in the last 4 matches, then find the average of the runs scored by him in the remaining 2 matches.
questions.solution:
• Average runs in total 10 matches = 15

∴ sum of runs in total 10 matches = 15 × 10 = 150. 

 
• Average runs in first 4 matches = 14

∴ sum of runs in first 4 matches = 14 × 4 = 56. 

 
• Average runs in last 4 matches = 12

∴ sum of runs in last 4 matches = 12 × 4 = 48. 

 
• Sum of runs in the remaining 2 matches = total runs in 10 matches - (sum of runs in first 4 matches + sum of runs in last 4 matches)

∴ sum of runs in remaining 2 matches = 150 - (56 + 48) = 150 - 104 = 46.​

⇒ average of runs in remaining 2 matches = 46 ÷ 2 = 23

Hence, the correct answer is "23".

questions.question:
**Directions: **Answer the question given below

You are the officer in-charge of security at a politicians son's birthday party. Its a kids party with a magician performing at one kiosk. You have a suspicion that the magician is carrying a weapon in his bag. What will be your course of action?

options.text: You will keep an eye on the magician.
You will silently get the magician's bag checked.
You will not ruin the party by taking any action on the magician.
You will take the magician in custody.

questions.solution:
In the given case, you only have a suspicion on the magician. Taking any action on the magician can backfire. So option 4 is eliminated.

However, you cannot let the suspicion be unattended. So option 3 is also eliminated.

If you only keep an eye on the magician, he may act quickly and you may be left unaware of his actions. So as a precaution it would be better to get his bag checked silently i.e without letting anyone know.

Hence the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: If 7 September 2012 is a Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 December 2014?
questions.solution:
Given that:

The day on 7th September 2012 is** Friday.**

 
• No of days from 7 September to 17 December = 23 + 31 + 30 + 17 = 101 
 
• Since, it was Friday on 7th September 2012, every 7th day from 7th September will be a Friday.
 
• Thus, no. of odd days = 101/7 = 3 odd days.
 
• Now,7 September 2012 (Friday) + 3 odd days = 17 December 2012 (Monday)
 
• The day on 17 December 2014 = 17 December 2012 + 2 days (Every year a date get shifts forward to the Next day. That means after 2 years, would shift ahead by 2 days.)
 
• The day on 17 December 2014 is** Wednesday**.​

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Ratio of the present ages of M and N is 7 : 6. Sum of the present age of M and N is 52 years. Then find the age of M.
questions.solution:
The ratio of the present ages of M and N is 7 : 6.

Let the common multiple be x.

So, the present age of M = 7x and the present age of N = 6x.

The sum of the present age of M and N is 52 years.

According to question:

7x + 6x = 52

13x = 52

x = 4

**Age of M = 7x**

**= 7 × 4 = 28 years**

Age of N = 6x

= 6 × 4 = 24** **

Hence, the age of M is 28 years.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decided which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mobile are instruments,

All instruments are heavy items.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some mobiles are heavy items.

II. No mobile is a heavy item.

III. Some heavy items are instruments.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions III and either conclusion I or II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b8852c9b03afec7f14d06191ce66c754c5604f5e99a051e0dc15b79edd43876.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some mobiles are heavy items. → True (Some mobile are instruments and all instruments are heavy items)

II. No mobile is a heavy item. → False (conclusion I is true)

III. Some heavy items are instruments. → True (all instruments are heavy items)

Hence, only conclusion I and III follows.

questions.question:
Directions: Answer the question given below.

You received an urgent task from your senior officer but you have an intuition that the task will require a breach of some laws. What will you do?

options.text: Ignore the orders and do nothing keeping your conscience clear.
Pass that order to your subordinates so that you would not be responsible for anything wrong.
Trust your senior officer and obey his order and communicate to seniors in case you notice that a specific law is breached or about to be breached.
Investigate on your own volition by using spies and inform the seniors of the findings of your investigation.

questions.solution:
As the officer from whom you received the order is senior to you and you have directly received the order from him only. Hence, you should trust him and obey his order as per the rules. Intuition is not a valid or strong enough reason to disobey a command. However, you may inform your senior if you come across a specific breach of law while carrying out the task.

Hence, the correct answer is **‘Option 3’**.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

45 * 17 * 3 * 41 * 81 * 9 * 56
questions.solution:
Here, we need to apply the combination of signs to get the correct equation.

Given: 

First we will check options one by one as below:

1) +, =, -, ×, ÷, +

Rightarrow 45 + 17 = 3 - 41 × 81 ÷ 9 + 56

Applying BODMAS rule, we will get, 

Rightarrow 45 + 17 = 3 - **41 ****× ****9** + 56

Rightarrow **45 + 17 **= **3** - 369 **+ 56**

**⇒ **62 =** 59 - 369**

Rightarrow 62 = -310, is not possible. This is not true.**

2) +, -, =, ×, +, -

Rightarrow 45 + 17 - 3 = **41 × 81** + 9 - 56

Applying BODMAS rule, we will get, 

Rightarrow **45 + 17** - 3 = **3321 + 9** - 56 

⇒ **62 - 3** = **3330 - 56**

Rightarrow 59 = 3274, is not possible. This is not true.

3) =, -, ×, +, -, +

Rightarrow 45 = 17 -** 3 × 41** + 81 - 9 + 56

Applying BODMAS rule, we will get, 

Rightarrow 45 = **17** - 123 **+ 81** - 9 **+ 56**

**⇒ **45 = 154** **- 123 - 9

⇒ 45 = 154 - 132

Rightarrow 45 = 22, is not possible. This is not true.

4) =, ×, +, +, ÷, -

Rightarrow 45 = 17 × 3 + 41 +** 81 ÷ 9** - 56

Applying BODMAS rule, we will get, 

Rightarrow 45 = **17 × 3** + 41 + 9 - 56

Rightarrow 45 = **51 + 41 + 9 **- 56

⇒ 45 = **101 - 56**

Rightarrow 45 = 45, is possible. This is true.

Hence, the combination of signs ' __**=, ×, +, +, ÷, -**__' is used to get correct balanced equation.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] __Confusion Points__**** Keep in mind to apply BODMAS rule, while solving these types of problems.

questions.question:
Select the option that will correctly fit in the blank space in the given figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf5a460be33648a39a711a517b45856867df29097fdce7832677892fa1173f3.png]
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1. The figure with the least number of sides from the outer four figures shifts to the centre and the earlier central figure vanishes.

2. The vacant position of the figure which moves to the centre is occupied by its diagonally opposite figure.

3. Remaining two diagonal elements or figures also interchange their positions.

4. And the vacant position thus created is occupied by a new figure whose number of sides is one more than the previously highest-sided figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf4ac18253cc87252779aa5daba3e20ed1f8f733432b4084c85edb2ada744f92.png] 

Hence, figure in **option 2 **will come next in the series.
